outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Combining ultrasound parameters (AC, EFW, FAST) with clinical parameters improved predictive power for LGA in women with GDM, and adding FAST to standard ultrasound parameters improved prediction of hypoglycemia in fetuses with AC > 75th percentile.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was one of the outcomes assessed, but specific findings related to mode of delivery are not reported.
